DashboardFeaturedCampaigns.title: Featured Campaigns
DashboardFeaturedCampaigns.description: Hand-picked list shown on the influencer home page at the top (Deal Of The Day stacked carousel). Plan Your Stay With Us is curated separately under <link>Plan Your Stay</link>. Lower position = appears first.
DashboardFeaturedCampaigns.emptyState: No featured campaigns yet. Click <feature>Feature a campaign</feature> to add one.
DashboardFeaturedCampaigns.placeholderNote: Until you publish at least one, the influencer home falls back to a built-in placeholder list.
